make-transcript-hint: Made from the episode's audio. This takes a few minutes.
make-transcript-making: Making the transcript… You can keep listening.
make-transcript-slow: The transcript still isn't ready after 30 minutes. It may still be in progress.
make-transcript-off: Transcription is off. Set TRANSCRIPTION_API_BASE_URL and TRANSCRIPTION_API_KEY in .env (free with a Groq key), then restart the app.
make-transcript-not-allowed: Only an admin can make transcripts. Ask the person who runs this server.
make-transcript-too-large: Long episodes can be bigger than the transcription service accepts.
make-transcript-missing: Transcription finished without a transcript. Try again.
make-transcript-error: The transcript couldn't be started. Check your connection and try again.
make-transcript-download-error: The episode didn't finish downloading. Try again.
